result.summary: Found 1 issue: a minor layout inconsistency in the 'Fastest near you' carousel where the first card's image is shorter than the others, causing misaligned titles and delivery info.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel, the first card (Green Bowl Poké) has a shorter image height than the adjacent cards (Smash Bros Burgers, Trattoria Piccol...). As a result, its title and delivery fee sit higher on the screen, breaking the horizontal alignment of card titles and metadata across the row.
issues.suggestion: Enforce a consistent fixed image/aspect-ratio height for all cards in the carousel so that titles and delivery info align on the same baseline across items.
